thread:
Rina Kaur: FYI running a targeted canary on ember-2b-ptq for funcall JSON compliance. parse_fail ~7.9% over 300 samples. most failures are tiny: stray escape sequences, dangling commas, or escaped null chars (\u0000) inserted mid-string.
Diego Lopez: escaped nulls? that smells like tokenizer changes under quantized kernels. fp32 baseline?
Rina Kaur: fp32 ~0.1%. so definitely quant-onboard regression.
Samir Banerjee: any correlation w/ kvcache or prompt prefix length?
Rina Kaur: yes, failures skew to kvcache hits and longer prefixes. hypothesize boundary tokenization emitting null-ish token.
Diego Lopez: saved repro bundle s3://canaries/ember-ptq/null-5370.jsonl (includes seed and decode params).
Rina Kaur: quick raw examples pasted: `{"tool":"fetch","args":{"q":"name\u0000Smith"}}` (null inside string) and `{"cmd": "list",}` (trailing comma).
Samir Banerjee: mitigation plan: 1) A/B cohorts kvcache ON/OFF, 2) add rescue pipeline: remove control-chars, repair trailing commas, then strict-parse, 3) test retry temp=0.0. record recovery path.
Rina Kaur: did quick local: retry-only recovers ~18%, sanitize+retry ~78% on small set.
canary-bot: canary started: ember-2b-ptq | cohorts: kvcache-on/off | samples=600
Diego Lopez: if kvcache implicated, block PTQ onboarding until root cause addressed. add a unit in funcall harness that injects escaped nulls to catch regressions.
Rina Kaur: launching now, will post summary + token diffs when done.
